notes.title: Demo v1.095 update
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994453/4888843c14f261be41129b9dc052793d0621aac2.png"][/img][/p][p]Finally I found the correct tool and correct way to fix all (almost) the camera problems! [/p][p][/p][p]1, Aiming mechanic changed. There are not dead angle any more when aiming left side, because the whole body will move.[/p][p]2, Smoother camera control, and the camera will not go through the wall. (Most situations. If too fast it will still go through) It will shrink the distance like many other 3rd person games.[/p][p]3, If you are using mouse keyboard, the mouse control is much better.[/p][p]4, Camera FOV increased a little.[/p][p]5，Critical stab mechanic changed, it will delay a little bit, makes more tense. Just follow the hint you will make it.[/p][p]6, Footstep sound added.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo v1.09 update
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994453/e90413a10d414e8a996a124bb231c0adf5007ffd.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]1, The Confirm Key can be customized now, south button or the east button. [/p][p]2, Brightness can be adjusted now.[/p][p]3, Melee battle mechanic fine-tuned, quicker and easier to trigger the execution.[/p][p]4, Added a new crazy scene at the beginning, with some Control  Guides. If you load the game you will miss this scene, unless starting a new game.[/p][p]5, Added heart beat and breathing sounds for heavy injury state, feeling more tense.[/p][p]6, Gunman bullet mechanic changed, it will show the trajectory after shooting.[/p][p]7, Sounds and Ambient are with higher quality now. The jarring noise vanished.[/p][p]8, Many other small changes.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]v1.091[/p][p]Got a lot useful feedbacks, and I finally found out what causes the parry delay problem, and fixed it! Now it will be triggered just at the moment you press the parry key, more fitting the intuition. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo v1.08 update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994453/394031254439e644dbe44f297048a2dba7ead665.png[/img]


1, Mouse control mode completely changed.  Setting : Menu key - Config - view control - mouse. 
2, Many values fine-tuned. It still needs some technics for the battle, but at least it will be more fault-tolerant now.
3, Added a new practise scene with some surprises. Don't need to find it, you will naturally go into it.
4, Other UI modifications. 
5, Stair physics fine-tuned.
6, Some costume details changed, more like about 1695.

And,
Discord server open! Please feel free to join an discuss the game !
https://discord.gg/RMUarnR68g

notes.title: Demo update v1.065
notes.content:
v1.065 update

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994453/a700c261f4acec7c216e698b71630a70abf2cd47.png[/img]


v1.065 update

-Gun aiming mechanic updated. You dont need to align the protagonist and the camera direction anymore. Aiming will automatically point to camera direction. 

-Fixed a fatal mouse view speed bug.

-Fixed a back stab trigger bug.

-Dialogs became slower, more easy to read. 

-English text got a little bit better (Maybe still not so native). 

-Fixed keyboard shortcut key function.

-Added a quit game button in gameplay.

-Improved the door openning animation.

-Other small changes




v1.06 update

-View and aim camera speed can be tweaked to fit different kind of gamepads now.

-Full screen available now.

-Refined a liitle bit the melee attack. 

-Mouse control Y axis changed to scroll wheel, otherwise to use Arrow key must set "Config - view ctrl" to "Gamepad". 

-Recommanded input order: Gamepad > keyboard > mouse

-Multi-language interface almost finished (except UI).

-Other very small tiny changes.

notes.content:

notes.title: Demo update v1.03
notes.content:
demo v1.03 update:

-Walking not straightly problem fixed. (I think I really got the point this time)
-Can hit the enemy after it fell down on the floor, and it can effectively reduce emeny's toughness.
-Changed the mouse-view control, if you are using mouse, please trigger the option at the config menu. It should be better than v1.0, just still recommend to use gamepad.
-Config menu can be trigger anytime in the gameplay, below the Condition option. 
-Added a pixelized mode, looks more Retro, can be also trigger at the Config menu.
